pages.text: Hold forward to accelerate; release it to coast. Backward brakes first, then reverses if held. Left and right steer.$(br2)Drive from the single seat, the left position of a two-seat bench, or the middle of a three-seat bench. Other seats carry passengers.

While moving forward, tap $(k:sprint) to raise the speed limit until forward is released.$(br2)Standard boxes are fastest; extended boxes are intermediate; wide boxes are slower. More occupied slots reduce boost and acceleration. Load is counted by slots: a mat occupies three; a stool occupies one.

The server configuration controls speeds and cargo penalties. Loading or unloading while driving updates the speed limit.$(br2)Before departure, assemble the wagon entity, fill the required hitches and take the driver’s position.
